subject.title: fix: native landing accepts validation-empty draft CI

question: Should the native landing flow require successful canonical CI preflight/job-level evidence during hosted prepare and exact-head hosted revalidation immediately before merge?
rationale: The bug is clear, but the issue has the protected `maintainer` label and changes the repository's merge-safety boundary, so a maintainer should explicitly own the policy choice.

options.title: Patch landing gates now
options.body: Update hosted prepare and merge verification to reject validation-empty draft CI and add regression coverage for the draft-to-ready sequence.

options.title: Rely on branch protection
options.body: Keep `scripts/pr` narrower and depend on repository-required checks, accepting that the wrapper remains unsafe where required checks are absent.

options.title: Pause for broader landing design
options.body: Hold this issue for a larger maintainer redesign if the desired policy goes beyond the reported draft-CI hole.

recommendation.title: Patch landing gates now
recommendation.body: Update hosted prepare and merge verification to reject validation-empty draft CI and add regression coverage for the draft-to-ready sequence.

likelyOwner.reason: This login owns the most recent hosted-gate and CI workflow history and opened the issue with concrete evidence.
